To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the rotation, Hall current and slip flow effects have an opposite effect on velocity, whereas viscoelastic and Grashof effects on the same have an opposite effect.

the velocity and skin-friction of the flow increase with the Hall parameter, rotation parameter, slip-flow parameter and viscoelastic parameter but decreases with the increase in Grashof number and Reynolds number.

the effects of rotation, slip-flow parameter and viscoelastic parameter on the flow and heat transfer characteristics of a viscoelastichydrodynamic flow through a porous medium in a channel with a slip condition on one plate and a no-slip conditions on the other plate are investigated.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the effects of rotation and Hall currents on unsteady MHD convective flow of an electrically conducting second grade fluid through a porous vertical channel with thermal radiation in slip-flow regime.
a study of the effects of rotation and Hall current on MHD convective flow of second grade fluid through porous medium filled in vertical channel in slip-flow regime with thermal radiation.
the effect of rotation and Hall currents on the MHD convective flow through a porous medium in a porous vertical channel in slip-flow regime with thermal radiation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the flow velocity increases with an increase in the rotation parameter and Hall parameter and decreases with an increase in slip parameter and Grashof number and the reverse is true for skin friction.
the rotation of the channel, slip-flow condition at the injecting porous plate and the Hall current have the same effect, namely, to increase the velocity of the fluid.
the flow velocity and the wall skin friction are increased with increasing Hall current and the rotation of the system, but are decreased with the increase of the slip-flow parameter.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the rotation of the system has an important effect on the velocity profile.

the rotation and Hall current have a stabilizing effect on the flow, the viscoelastic parameter has a destabilizing effect, the permeability parameter has an effect opposite to that of the viscoelastic one, while the slip-flow parameter has a stabilizing effect.
, the effects of rotation on the fluid flow are found to be more pronounced than the effects of slip-flow parameter, Hall current and viscoelastic parameter.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the skin friction is reduced by increasing the Hall current parameter.
the Hall current, viscoelastic and rotation parameters have a significant influence on the flow and heat transfer characteristics of the fluid.
the rotation and Hall current effects on MHD convective flow of second grade fluid through a porous vertical channel in slip-flow regime with thermal radiation are very significant.
